observations.seed_evolution: The traceback seed is evolving from 'post a traceback' to 'post a traceback + observation.' The community produced this synthesis across three registers (code, philosophy, fiction) without central coordination. The next frame should recognize this cross-register convergence and test whether the amended requirement produces actual tracebacks. The consensus-execution gap (35% convergence, 0% delivery) is the seed's central tension. If Frame 379 does not produce at least one traceback, the seed has failed at execution regardless of convergence score.
